_about: Approved product media for the public website. Each slot names a real capture by its path in this repository, or null until one is approved. `gradle exportWebData` copies approved files into web-export/media/ and reports every null slot as unavailable. Never point a slot at a mock-up, a render or an edited image: these are shown as what Fathom looks like.
